description: Shared fixtures for the function that turns an Instance's status into what a person sees:
a tone, a status word and whether the database is available.
The Go implementation (everestctl) and the TypeScript one (the UI) both run every case.
'kstatus' is what kstatus-based tools (Flux, Helm 4) make of the same object,
and 'wait' is the outcome of everestctl's --wait.
